messages:
Alex T: Heads-up — Enterprise prospect (FinServe) just sent over a CAIQ + SIG dump. Need clarifications on shared responsibility, KMS ownership, and a POC runbook. They want answers by EOD Thu. Link to their sheet: https://drive.google.com/finserve-caiq
Maria G: Thanks. Can we create a control mapping (CAIQ control -> our artifact) and call out variations for Hosted / Dedicated / Private? I can handle encryption, KMS, audit logging, tenant isolation.
Chris P: I can author the matrix. Quick q: for 'cryptography' section should we say Hosted supports provider KMS + optional BYOK; Dedicated/Private = customer-managed KMS?
Maria G: Correct. Hosted: provider-managed KMS by default; enterprise Hosted customers may enable BYOK (CMEK) — see internal doc https://internal.redwood/security/kms. Dedicated/Private: customer owns keys. We'll list both flavors in the mapping.
Raj K: POC suggestion: 2-week engagement. Week 1: ingest anonymized sample data, validate throughput/latency targets; Week 2: run encryption verification, network egress tests, and fallback policy validation. For Private POC we need VPC peering or temporary connectivity.
Amy S: @Maria @Chris can you also confirm pricing delta if they require BYOK + Private deployment? Prospect is sensitive to TCO.
Chris P: BYOK itself isn't a separate SKU but Private + platform fee applies. Ballpark delta vs Hosted list: +30-40% depending on GPU profile and retention. I'll draft a short pricing appendix.
Alex T: They also asked for SOC2 evidence and pen-test cadence.
Maria G: We can provide SOC2 Type II; pen tests are annual. We'll share a redacted report under NDA. Add that to the CAIQ evidence column.
Chris P: I'll produce a sanitized control mapping and a POC runbook. Sample runbook snippet to include in the CAIQ response:
```
steps:
  - provision dedicated GPU pool
  - configure model.version=redwood-instruct-5
  - enable prefix caching=true
  - run 10k representative queries (QPS=50)
  - validate KV cache hit rates and tail latency
```
Raj K: For shared responsibility language propose: "Redwood manages inference runtime, model serving, kernel selection, and physical/virtual infrastructure. Customer is responsible for data classification, supplying BYOK keys when opted, tenant data ingestion, and network/VPC configuration." Use that verbatim in the CAIQ 'Shared Responsibility' text field.
Amy S: :thumbsup: I'll paste that into the sheet and update the evidence links. Plan to send back to the customer Fri AM.
DeployBot: Note: Created draft page https://confluence.redwood/eng/finserve-caiq-draft and attached current CAIQ mapping.
Maria G: I'll review the mapping before send. Also confirm log retention defaults: infra logs 90 days; audit trail for admin events 365 days with enterprise retention add-on.
Ellen L: Looping in Legal. We'll prep an NDA template and review redactions for SOC2.
Alex T: Thanks — can we do a quick sync in 30m to finalize language and assign the deliverables?
Amy S: I'm on it, I'll set the 30m huddle and own final send.
Maria G: I'll be on the call and will sign off on security text.
Chris P: Will bring the pricing appendix.
Raj K: I'll have the POC runbook + infra checklist ready.
Alex T: Great, appreciate the quick turn.
